LanguageData.SWCP_Reinforcements_Button_Desc: Call for reinforcements from your faction. Amount of troopers they send depends on your current relations.
LanguageData.SWCP_Enlist_Letter_Label:
Howdy, this is a message from your commanding officer. I would like to formally welcome you to the finest army the wastes have ever seen, The {FACTION_name} Army. Be ready to make yourself available and report to any of our bases or cities to enhance your skills.

 You will be issued a standard salary every week for you and your troopers as well as provisions that can be picked up at our bases when you are not on patrol. The {FACTION_name} military has fine facilities in order to better train your troopers, use them wisely.

 If you're patroling the mojave good luck, almost makes you wish for a nuclear winter.
LanguageData.SWCP_Provisions_Desc_Standard_Issue:

- ×2 NCR Army Uniform Crate
